source.whyItFits: No single open paper taught both examinations. The Brain Circulation review lists the early non-contrast CT signs of MCA infarction. The Japanese Journal of Radiology review states how acute PE looks on CT pulmonary angiography and which CTPA findings indicate right-ventricular dysfunction. Haemorrhage patterns are not in the CT-head paper, so they are not questioned.
